data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter slider for confirming actions with loading and success feedback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slider widget that triggers an async action when slid, shows a loading animation, then a success or failure animation. Supports LTR and RTL directions and extensive visual customization.
use_when: You need a confirm‑action UI element with built‑in loading and success feedback
Your app requires RTL support for sliders
You want a highly customizable slider without writing your own animation logic
avoid_when: A simple button or tap gesture is sufficient
You need a non‑slider interaction pattern
You prefer a package with stable API (this package has several breaking changes)
